author: chin✨
title: Commission fanfic character art (2-character half body)
content:
Hi, lovely artists! I am looking for an artist to commission for an art (HAHA I’m not explaining this well, am I?) 🤦‍♀️

I’m currently working on a fanfic, and it would be sooo nice to have an art that would represent it. Here are some of the things I would appreciate:

🚫No AI allowed 
👤Half body (includes 2 characters in one art)
💖May or may not have experience drawing KPop idols (can capture features well)
🌈Loves working with colors
🏴‍☠️Not required to be an ATINY, but I want to support the community. 
😭I’m sorry, no anime/cartoon artstyle
📅Deadline: Not rushed; work at your own pace, but would be great to have it ready before November. 

Please send your comms sheet or you can also dm me your rates. Thank you so much! ✨

#ATEEZfanart #artcommission #artcomms
